title: Synthesis 3: organized dividing bodies are easy now; intrinsic turnover is the bottleneck for heredity
summary: Since synthesis 2 (P 54 -> 62, K 0 -> 2): metabolic FCH micelles (IBWD) and pcell's contained, selected yield (SIDH) are established, and the kstrail and phase_membrane twins are decided. Three independent controls show that the heredity routes lack intrinsic turnover (membrane_evo freezes without disks, metabolic micelles stop at a carrying capacity, crawlers jam); boundaries that do work (shell needed for metabolism, ring lost in uniform-D twins) are the strongest B evidence. Next: a death process that frees resource, and metabolism with conserved body matter.
